title: Shirring and Crease Principle
content: ### Shirring principle In this course, we will explore the different types of shirring shapes based on fabric. In addition to the wrinkles generated by the default fabric, there are various types of wrinkles, such as narrow wrinkles and wide wrinkles. You can achieve the desired wrinkles by adjusting the Detail items in the Fabric Property, but it may be challenging for beginners. However, if you understand the differences in how each fabric forms wrinkles, you can easily create various styles of wrinkles. ### Crease principle In this course, we will learn about the shape of creases based on fabric. When fabrics are stretched or overlapped with each other, various creases are formed based on the type of fabric. Following the Shirring principle, you can refer to the creases made for each fabric and apply them to the clothes you plan to create in the future.
content_description: This web page aims to provide an insightful overview of shirring and crease principles in fabric design, helping users understand and create diverse styles of wrinkles and creases for their clothing projects.

title: Can I Pause my Subscription?
content: ## **Q. Can I temporarily pause my subscription?** **A.** Yes, you can temporarily pause your subscription instead of canceling it. Your payment details will be saved, so you can easily resume your subscription without needing to repurchase it from scratch. _* Only personal monthly licenses can be paused. (Enterprise License, Student License, Trial License are not applicable)_ * * * ## ## **Subscription Pause** 1\. Log in to your account and go to the 'License' page. 2\. Click on **'Stop Subscription'**. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438238983705) 3\. Select **'Pause Subscription'** and choose a pause period of up to 6 months. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438283892633) 4\. Your subscription status will change to **'Pause Scheduled'** , meaning the pause will take effect once your current license expires. * * * ## ## **Additional Notes:** * While the status is **'Pause Scheduled'** , you can select **'Undo Pause'** to keep your subscription active. * During the pause period, you can **'Resume'** your subscription at any time before the pause ends. A new billing cycle will begin when you resume your subscription. * Any coupon discounts you have will still be valid after the pause period. * * * ## ## **Status Details:** #### ✅ **Active** Your license is currently active, and payments are being processed as expected. You have full access to Marvelous Designer. #### ⏳ **Pause Scheduled** Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a pause has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled pause date. #### 🚫 **Paused** Your license remains active, but payments have been stopped, and Marvelous Designer is no longer accessible. #### 📅 **Cancel Scheduled** Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a cancellation has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled cancellation date.
content_description: Learn how to easily pause your subscription for up to six months without losing your payment details, ensuring a seamless return to service when you're ready.

Please click**"Contact US"** button for further assistance._ _*For enterprise user, end user id can ONLY be deleted on the license admin page_ ![mceclip3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438078459545) 4\. title: When I try to login, I get the following massage "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time"
content: This error message occurs when there is a failure between server connections. In case you are receiving this message while using the Marvelous Designer 8, then please first check if your network connection is stable or you have input wrong password or not. If you input the right login credential, you would be able to activate the license successfully with the onlineauth method. If you keep facing this issue however, please refer to the ([manual page](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358427341465)) for offline authentication method activation. For all the other versions with the same issue, please follow the instructions below for its solution. Also, please make our server address whitelist on your antivirus program. ![with.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097204377) * **With “Firewall Option” enabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. When you login, please check on the box saying “If using a Firewall, mark this checkbox”. 3. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 4. Please activate the license. ![without.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438112145689) * **With “Firewall Option” disabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 3. Please activate the license. **[How to open port 443 and whitelist Marvelous Designer’s server IP address.]** **1\. Open the control panel and go to 'Windows Defender Firewall' sections.** ![Xwaqc1aLWHzM0RKZWm5Phggk3suThFUkJYj8AIe7kiWJIdr1DvYVne9eXxunzy2oFpxgfCGTWT7OPnfYklNbMjQD1OZkb12QfrdXCgXTfNQg2ElNrH3XOkZgh0sxKfcA4Vq1Zto5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438162539801) **2 Go to 'Advanced settings' and click 'Inbound Rules'.** ![4dK68hcJOhqp7mRu0Ym7az9xExTFwR7xOm1065mQKOZaepfbn7xVpMjt3QrpwPni6VgAz0o9izAL9mXmMSkj4ed8izWStWhv-ydTtMO45nV5svqIprl4bK0cDmT2u3P45nhyoTVB.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097738905) **3\. On 'Action' menu, click 'New Rule'.** ![zTxrlfuGDX5qr_TWWaT4fssmuj3lCguT9KoHMrOFsdNrmAA3Gf6c_T05SbqupRo7-PO6V2WNSwNPF4IbcpN656bYALlITJ1OZlbkB_G7c08E62HLJURs9cOOjuKjGwZ078BQyl4Y.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098004761) **4\. title: Compatible File Format
content: ### Compatible File Format File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, also in a addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | .sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive overview of compatible file formats for importing and exporting 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, including details on their contents and usage.
